title: Retained Balance Cushion for Owners with a Thin Checking Relationship
content:
The balance an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts must retain is raised for owners whose checking relationship is thin. Two facts are read from the owner's account under Personal Checking: the ledger balance it carries, and the direct deposits credited to it in the three calendar months ending on the instruction date.

| Personal Checking ledger balance | Direct deposits in the three calendar months ending on the instruction date | Balance the account must retain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| below 2500.00 USD | less than 1000.00 USD | the tier's minimum daily balance waiver threshold plus 5000.00 USD |
| below 2500.00 USD | at least 1000.00 USD | the tier's minimum daily balance waiver threshold plus 2000.00 USD |
| 2500.00 USD or more | any | the tier's minimum daily balance waiver threshold |

### A worked case on hypothetical inputs

Take a savings account on a tier whose minimum daily balance waiver threshold is a hypothetical 4000.00 USD.

Where the owner's Personal Checking ledger balance is 1800.00 USD with 600.00 USD of direct deposits in the window, the account must retain 9000.00 USD. Where that ledger balance is 1800.00 USD with 1500.00 USD of direct deposits, it must retain 6000.00 USD. Where the ledger balance is 9000.00 USD, no cushion is added and it must retain 4000.00 USD.

### Boundary figures

A ledger balance of exactly 2500.00 USD carries no cushion at all; 2499.99 USD carries one. Direct deposits of exactly 1000.00 USD give the 2000.00 USD cushion, and 999.99 USD give the 5000.00 USD cushion.
